subject: Ten gaming resort casino halls, Despicable’s store and a shared prop kit for Explore
sources: assets/resort-interiors/ (editable .blend files written by the generator)
method: Original procedural geometry (boxes, lathes, tori, extrusions) with flat-colour materials named resort_<finish>; the game replaces each material with a procedural finish shader in the resort palette. No bitmap textures, scans, purchased, downloaded or third-party models or artwork are used.
lettering: Sign lettering is set at runtime from the bundled fonts (Fontdiner Swanky, BioRhyme, BioRhyme Expanded, Atomic Age) under their own licences; no lettering is baked into these models.
